ZE_PLANTS_VS_ZOMBIES
=============================
Map author:
花泽爱吃香菜
皮皮猫233
SIRloin
佐贺
=============================
This is a zombie escape map with the theme 
of Plants vs. Zombies
This map participates
2025Return to Roots - Mapping Contest
The map contains 15 types of human plants 
and 9 special zombies
3 levels of normal+3 levels of extreme
=============================
Please note that this map requires a server:
Disable color correction plugin
Disable mat_fullbright 1
Enable snd_musicvolume 1
to achieve the best experience
Recommended: 
Mother Zombie's max health >=50,000
Little zombie's max health 10,000-20,000
This version is an incomplete version
does not represent the final version
If you have any bugs, please contact our team
Enjoy yourself
=============================
Now we have the function of switching between 
Chinese and English texts
Break the wooden door of the hall inside the server,
or use noclip in single-player mode to press the button
To obtain the switch between Chinese and English
